definitions.explanation: During the Edo period, warehouses maintained by feudal domains in major commercial cities, especially Osaka, to store and sell rice and other products from their territories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蔵屋敷|くらやしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There were many domain warehouses in Osaka.

examples.japanese: {各藩|かくはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蔵屋敷|くらやしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{年貢米|ねんぐまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}りさばいた→売りさばく：28318_urisabaku⟧。
examples.english: Each domain sold its tax rice through its warehouse estate.

examples.japanese: {蔵屋敷|くらやしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{拠点|きょてん}→拠点：05628_kyoten⟧で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「⟦{天下|てんか}→天下：12188_tenka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だった。
examples.english: Domain warehouses were important bases supporting each domain's economy, and were one of the reasons Osaka was called 'the kitchen of the nation.'

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A key institution of Edo-period commercial life. Osaka, as the center of rice trading, had the highest concentration of {蔵屋敷|くらやしき}. Each feudal domain (⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧) maintained one or more of these in Osaka or Edo to convert their rice tax (⟦{年貢|ねんぐ}→年貢：16287_nengu⟧) into cash. The {蔵屋敷|くらやしき} system contributed to the development of Japan's early commodity markets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蔵屋敷|くらやしき} (Osaka domain warehouses)
- ⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蔵屋敷|くらやしき} (a domain's warehouse estate)
- {蔵屋敷|くらやしき}⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ (site of a former domain warehouse)
